title: 10 Things a Godly Man Does in the Last Hour of His Workday
caption:
Most guys coast through the last hour. Refreshing email, looking busy, waiting for five. Then tomorrow starts behind and nobody knows why.

The last hour is where a man of God sets up the next day. He answers the email he's been avoiding, closes the loops he promised, owns the mistake, thanks the guy who helped, and hands the whole day to God before he logs off. Then he walks in the door present.

"Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men." Colossians 3:23

Save this for 4 PM tomorrow.
